title: Open section operations on module presheaves preserve sheaves
statement:
Let $X$ be a topological space, $\mathcal O_X$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $X$, and $U\subseteq X$ open, with inclusion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$. Give $X$ and $U$ their sites of open subsets and open coverings [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and set $\mathcal O_U(W)=\mathcal O_X(W)$ for open $W\subseteq U$, with the inherited ring restrictions. Use presheaves of modules and their sectionwise linear morphisms [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], and sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For an $\mathcal O_X$-module presheaf $\mathcal P$ define $R\mathcal P(W)=\mathcal P(W)$ for $W\subseteq U$, with its existing scalar actions and restrictions, and set $(R\mu)_W=\mu_W$ on morphisms. For an $\mathcal O_U$-module presheaf $\mathcal Q$ define $D\mathcal Q(V)=\mathcal Q(V\cap U)$ for open $V\subseteq X$, with restriction along $V'\subseteq V$ equal to that of $\mathcal Q$ along $V'\cap U\subseteq V\cap U$, and with scalar action $a\cdot t=\rho_V(a)t$, where $\rho_V:\mathcal O_X(V)\to\mathcal O_U(V\cap U)$ is ring restriction; set $(D\nu)_V=\nu_{V\cap U}$ on morphisms. Then $\mathcal O_U$ is a sheaf of rings; $R$ and $D$ define functors between the corresponding module-presheaf categories, and each sends module sheaves to module sheaves. Thus they restrict to functors $R:\Mod(\mathcal O_X)\to\Mod(\mathcal O_U)$ and $D:\Mod(\mathcal O_U)\to\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$. Explicitly, the restrictions of $D\mathcal Q$ are semilinear: for $V'\subseteq V$ open, $a\in\mathcal O_X(V)$ and $t\in\mathcal Q(V\cap U)$,
$$(\rho_V(a)t)|_{V'\cap U}=\rho_{V'}(a|_{V'})\,t|_{V'\cap U}.$$
For every $\mathcal Q$ and open $W'\subseteq W\subseteq U$, $D\mathcal Q(W)=\mathcal Q(W)$ with the same $\mathcal O_X(W)=\mathcal O_U(W)$-action, and the restriction from $W$ to $W'$ is the restriction of $\mathcal Q$. For every open $V\subseteq X$, the restriction $D\mathcal Q(V)\to D\mathcal Q(V\cap U)$ is the identity on $\mathcal Q(V\cap U)$.

proof.text: Package P with its given sheaf condition as a SheafOfModules object and apply moduleSheafOpenRestriction. Its isSheaf field is exactly the first clause. Similarly package Q and apply moduleSheafOpenDirectImage to prove the second clause. Mathlib SheafOfModules.overFunctor and SheafOfModules.pushforward already implement the cover and intersection arguments of Stacks 00A0(2) and 008W. The restricted ring sheaf is the existing (moduleRings X).over U.

The two squares with forgetful functors and the direct-image scalar-action formula are definitional equalities of the existing constructors. Semilinearity is PresheafOfModules.map_smul applied to the direct-image presheaf, whose underlying map and scalar action reduce to the displayed expressions.

For an object W over U, use the product projections and the lift of (W.hom, identity) to show U product W.left equals W.left by antisymmetry. CostructuredArrow.obj_ext then gives (Over.star U).obj W.left = W. For the module-object identity, generalize to equal objects A and B and a map of their underlying opens. Eliminate the equality; the map is the identity because the category of opens is thin. Functor.map_id makes the scalar map the identity ring map, and restriction of scalars along it reduces to the original module.

The underlying abelian-presheaf map of direct image is Q.presheaf.map on the image under Over.star. Transport its endpoints along the preceding equalities; Over.OverMorphism.ext and thinness of opens identify it with Q.presheaf.map i.op. Finally apply the same transport to the map induced by prod.snd from U product (U product V) to U product V. Its endpoints are equal, hence this arrow is the identity; Q.presheaf.map_id proves the final identity. No sheaf hypothesis is used in these computations.
